description: Trains a YOLO (detect, segment, classify) or HuggingFace (classify, detect) model and writes a standard metrics.json.

inputs.name: dataset
inputs.description: The training dataset folder on a Tapis file system. It is copied into the job and passed to the trainer as --data (plus `data_file` when set). Leave unwired only for a HuggingFace detection run that uses `hub_dataset`.

outputs.name: model
outputs.description: The trained model: weights/best.pt for YOLO (a file, as yolo_inference expects), best_model/ for HuggingFace (model + image processor).

framework.description: Training backend. 'yolo' = Ultralytics YOLO v8–v11 (detect, segment, classify). 'huggingface' = Transformers Auto models (classify, detect; no segmentation).

task.description: What the model predicts: 'classify' (one label per image), 'detect' (boxes), 'segment' (masks; YOLO only).

model.description: YOLO: a checkpoint name (yolov8n.pt, yolo11m-seg.pt, …; auto-downloaded) or a path to your own .pt to fine-tune. HuggingFace: a Hub model ID or local directory compatible with the task's Auto class.

name.description: Experiment folder name; outputs go to <task>/<name>/ in the run's archive folder, and the model/metrics outputs point there. Each run has its own archive folder, so the default never collides.

model_artifact.description: Which file or folder inside the experiment folder the `model` output points at: weights/best.pt for YOLO, best_model for HuggingFace. The settings page keeps this matched to the framework.

data_file.description: File inside the dataset folder to pass as --data, e.g. data.yaml for YOLO detection/segmentation. Empty passes the folder itself (classification, HuggingFace detection). Keep the yaml's `path:` relative (or omit it) so it resolves inside the job.

hub_dataset.description: HuggingFace detection only: a Hub dataset ID (e.g. detection-datasets/coco) to download instead of a wired dataset. A slice of train_samples/val_samples images is used.

epochs.description: Full passes over the training set.

batch_size.description: Images per step, per device. Lower it if the GPU runs out of memory.

device.description: Compute device. 'cuda' needs a GPU node.

patience.description: Early stopping: stop after this many epochs without improvement.

workers.description: Dataloader worker processes (YOLO only; HuggingFace always uses 0).

imgsz.description: YOLO: training image size in pixels; rounded to the nearest multiple of 32.

lrf.description: YOLO: final learning rate as a fraction of lr0 (final LR = lr0 × lrf).

optimizer.description: YOLO: optimizer. 'auto' picks SGD or AdamW from the dataset size and epochs.

cos_lr.description: YOLO: use a cosine learning-rate schedule instead of linear decay.

warmup_epochs.description: YOLO: epochs of learning-rate warmup (fractions allowed).

warmup_momentum.description: YOLO: momentum at the start of warmup.

warmup_bias_lr.description: YOLO: bias learning rate at the start of warmup.

fraction.description: YOLO: fraction of the training set to use (1.0 = all). Handy for quick trial runs.

freeze.description: YOLO: freeze the first N layers (0 = train all layers). Freezing the backbone speeds up fine-tuning on small datasets.

close_mosaic.description: YOLO: turn off mosaic augmentation for the last N epochs.

save_period.description: YOLO: save a checkpoint every N epochs (-1 = only best.pt and last.pt).

resume.description: YOLO: resume an interrupted run. Set the model to that run's weights/last.pt.

profile.description: YOLO: profile ONNX/TensorRT speeds during training (slower).

hf_optimizer.description: HuggingFace: optimizer (any TrainingArguments.optim value, e.g. adamw_torch, adamw_torch_fused, adafactor, sgd).

gradient_accumulation_steps.description: HuggingFace: accumulate gradients over N steps; effective batch = batch size × N.

fp16.description: HuggingFace: mixed precision (faster, less memory). Ignored on CPU.

eval_strategy.description: HuggingFace: when to evaluate on the validation set.

save_total_limit.description: HuggingFace: checkpoints to keep on disk (older ones are deleted).

logging_steps.description: HuggingFace: log training loss every N steps.

train_samples.description: HuggingFace: train images to download when the dataset is a Hub dataset ID (detection only).

val_samples.description: HuggingFace: validation images to download when the dataset is a Hub dataset ID (detection only).

hf_token.description: Team secret with a HuggingFace access token, for gated or private Hub models/datasets. Passed to the job as HF_TOKEN.

wandb_key.description: Team secret with a Weights & Biases API key. Passed to the job as WANDB_API_KEY.

wandb_project.description: W&B project the run is logged under (WANDB_PROJECT). Only used when a W&B key is set.

hf_cache_dir.description: Optional folder on the execution system to keep downloaded HuggingFace models between runs (mounted at /app/hf_cache). It must already exist. Empty caches inside the job folder instead.

extra_args.description: Any other train_main.py flags, appended as-is (e.g. --nproc_per_node 2).

fileInputs.name: dataset
fileInputs.description: The whole dataset folder, copied into the job dir. Dropped when the port is unwired (Hub dataset runs).
